title: Pack Components by Area with a Top-to-Bottom Palette
written_solution: The first-column singletons form a top-to-bottom palette. Sort the green(3) components by area from largest to smallest, crop each one to its tight box, recolor them using the palette order, and pack them vertically with one background row between pieces.
